为感谢大家一直以来对本作品的支持，现开启月票抽奖活动！
活动时间：8月1日0点至8月7日20:59
参与方式：活动期间，向本书投出起点月票即可自动参与抽奖。多投多得抽奖次数，抽奖号码是投票时起点自动生成的月票号。
一等奖：价值139元的正版铜师傅《越王剑》小号手办
截止8月7日20:59为止，投月票数第一必得，另抽1份，一共2份。
二等奖：3000起点币，以红包形式发放，请获奖读者自行充值起点币
截止8月7日20:59为止，投月票数第2到第6必得（票数相同时，先投的会被系统自动排前面），另抽5份，一共10份。
本活动仅计算首发站点起点月票，其他渠道不参与，敬请谅解。
7号21点后开奖，中奖信息公示贴会在起点评论区置顶半个月，里面有详细的领奖和查看月票号指南。届时请按里面的引导前往公众号填写登记信息，15号23:59截止登记，过时不候。

> Monthly ticket lottery in early August: Bronze Master figure starting at 3,000 coins (page 1)
Early August Monthly Ticket Lottery Bronze Master Figure 3000 Starting Coin (Page 1)
To thank everyone for your continued support of this work, the monthly ticket lottery is now open!
Event time: 0:00 on August 1st to 20:59 on August 7th
Participation method: During the event, you can automatically participate in the lottery by casting your starting point monthly ticket to this book. The more you vote, the more times you will win the lottery. The lottery number is the monthly ticket number automatically generated by the starting point when voting.
First Prize: Genuine Bronze Master's "Yue Wang Sword" trumpet figure worth 139 yuan
As of 20:59 on August 7, the person with the most monthly votes will win and another one will be drawn, for a total of 2.
Second prize: 3,000 starting points, distributed in the form of red envelopes. The winning readers are asked to recharge the starting points by themselves.
As of 20:59 on August 7, the 2nd to 6th monthly votes will win (if the number of votes is the same, the one who voted first will be automatically ranked first by the system), and another 5 will be drawn, for a total of 10.
This activity only counts the starting point monthly tickets for the first site, other channels will not participate, please understand.
The lottery will be drawn after 21:00 on the 7th. The winning information announcement post will be at the top of the comment area of ​​Qidian for half a month. It contains detailed guidelines for claiming the prize and checking the monthly ticket number. At that time, please follow the guidance inside and go to the official account to fill in the registration information. Registration will close at 23:59 on the 15th. No waiting will be done after the deadline.
